{{- $page := .page -}} {{- $class := or .class "episode-thumb" -}} {{- with $page.Params.image -}} {{- $imageParam := . -}} {{- $imagePath := strings.TrimPrefix "/" $imageParam -}} {{- $res := resources.Get $imagePath -}} {{- if $res -}} {{- $smallWebp := $res.Resize "320x webp" -}} {{- $mediumWebp := $res.Resize "640x webp" -}} {{- $largeWebp := $res.Resize "1024x webp" -}} {{- $smallJpg := $res.Resize "320x jpg" -}} {{- $mediumJpg := $res.Resize "640x jpg" -}} {{- $largeJpg := $res.Resize "1024x jpg" -}} {{- $alt := or $page.Params.image_alt (printf "Afbeelding bij blogpost %s" $page.Title) -}} {{- else -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
